# 21 def save_data_to_json(data: dict, file_name: str) -> None:

# 23     try:

# 26         log_message(f"Data saved to {file_name}")

# 28         log_message(f"Failed to save data: {str(e)}", "ERROR")
# 29 
# 30 def read_data_from_json(file_name: str) -> dict:
# 31     """Reads data from a JSON file."""

# 33         with open(file_name, "r") as f:
# 34             return json.load(f)
# 35     except Exception as e:
# 36         log_message(f"Failed to read data: {str(e)}", "ERROR")
# 37         return {}

# 5167     "import plotly.graph_objects as go\n",
# 5168     "\n",
# 5169     "#  Prepare nodes and links\n",
# 5170     "df[\"source\"] = df[\"called_by_type\"].fillna(\"start\")\n",
# 5171     "df[\"target\"] = df[\"provider_type\"]\n",
# 5172     "\n",
# 5173     "nodes = list(set(df[\"source\"]) | set(df[\"target\"]))\n",
# 5174     "node_indices = {name: i for i, name in enumerate(nodes)}\n",
# 5175     "\n",
# 5176     "link_data = (\n",
# 5177     "    df.groupby([\"source\", \"target\"])\n",
# 5178     "    .size()\n",
# 5179     "    .reset_index(name=\"count\")\n",
# 5180     "    .assign(\n",
# 5181     "        source_idx=lambda d: d[\"source\"].map(node_indices),\n",
# 5182     "        target_idx=lambda d: d[\"target\"].map(node_indices)\n",
# 5183     "    )\n",
# 5184     ")\n",
# 5185     "\n",
# 5186     "fig = go.Figure(go.Sankey(\n",
# 5187     "    node=dict(\n",
# 5188     "        pad=15,\n",
# 5189     "        thickness=20,\n",
# 5190     "        line=dict(color=\"black\", width=0.5),\n",
# 5191     "        label=nodes\n",
# 5192     "    ),\n",
# 5193     "    link=dict(\n",
# 5194     "        source=link_data[\"source_idx\"],\n",
# 5195     "        target=link_data[\"target_idx\"],\n",
# 5196     "        value=link_data[\"count\"]\n",
# 5197     "    )\n",
# 5198     "))\n",
# 5199     "\n",
# 5200     "fig.update_layout(title_text=\"🧩 Execution Flow (Provider Type Nesting)\", font_size=14)\n",
# 5201     "fig.show()\n"
# 5202    ]

# 7056     "\n",
# 7057     "This chart presents a **latency-weighted treemap** that reveals the **nested execution structure** of a CodeCritic run — from top-level orchestration down to fine-grained tooling.\n",
# 7058     "\n",
# 7059     "# # # #  🧠 What this code does:\n",
# 7060     "- **Builds a call hierarchy** by tracing each provider’s `called_by_type`, recursively reconstructing the execution path for every log entry.\n",
# 7061     "- **Flattens each path** into separate columns (e.g., `path_0`, `path_1`, ...) so Plotly can visualize the full call stack as a nested tree.\n",
# 7062     "- **Visualizes latency cost** using a treemap, where:\n",
# 7063     "  - Each **box** represents a provider type at a specific nesting level.\n",
# 7064     "  - **Box size** is proportional to total `latency_ms` contributed by that node and its descendants.\n",
# 7065     "  - **Color** corresponds to `provider_type`, using a colorblind-safe palette.\n",
# 7066     "\n",
# 7067     "# # # #  🔍 What you're observing:\n",
# 7068     "- The **upper-left boxes** show top-level orchestrators (e.g., `session`, `program`).\n",
# 7069     "- As you move inward (right and down), you see **nested calls** to `controller`, `system`, `state`, and ultimately `agent`, `tool`, `score`, etc.\n",
# 7070     "- **Larger boxes** deeper in the tree indicate subsystems that consume significant time (e.g., tools like `mypy`, `black`, `ruff`).\n",
# 7071     "- Hovering on a box reveals its exact path and latency.\n",

# 8398    "source": [
# 8399     "import plotly.express as px\n",
# 8400     "\n",
# 8401     "#  Step 1: Build edges and infer nesting path\n",
# 8402     "df[\"source\"] = df[\"called_by_type\"].fillna(\"root\")\n",
# 8403     "df[\"target\"] = df[\"provider_type\"]\n",
# 8404     "edges = list(zip(df[\"source\"], df[\"target\"]))\n",
# 8405     "\n",
# 8406     "#  Recursive path builder\n",
# 8407     "def build_path(row, edges):\n",
# 8408     "    if row[\"source\"] == \"root\":\n",
# 8409     "        return [\"root\", row[\"target\"]]\n",
# 8410     "    for src, tgt in edges:\n",
# 8411     "        if tgt == row[\"source\"]:\n",
# 8412     "            return build_path({\"source\": src, \"target\": tgt}, edges) + [row[\"target\"]]\n",
# 8413     "    return [\"root\", row[\"source\"], row[\"target\"]]\n",
# 8414     "\n",
# 8415     "df[\"call_path\"] = df.apply(lambda row: build_path(row, edges), axis=1)\n",
# 8416     "\n",
# 8417     "#  Step 2: Flatten call path into real columns\n",
# 8418     "path_df = df[\"call_path\"].apply(pd.Series)\n",
# 8419     "path_df.columns = [f\"path_{i}\" for i in path_df.columns]\n",
# 8420     "\n",
# 8421     "#  Step 3: Combine into sunburst data source\n",
# 8422     "path_df = path_df.fillna(\"\")\n",
# 8423     "\n",
# 8424     "#  Then proceed as before\n",
# 8425     "sunburst_data = pd.concat([df, path_df], axis=1)\n",
# 8426     "\n",
# 8427     "\n",
# 8428     "fig = px.treemap(\n",
# 8429     "    sunburst_data,\n",
# 8430     "    path=path_df.columns.tolist(),\n",
# 8431     "    values=\"latency_ms\",\n",
# 8432     "    color=\"provider_type\",\n",
# 8433     "    color_discrete_sequence=px.colors.qualitative.Safe,\n",
# 8434     "    title=\"📦 Treemap of Provider Execution Cost\"\n",
# 8435     ")\n",
# 8436     "fig.show()\n"
# 8437    ]

# 8444     "# # #  🗺️ Provider Flow by Actor Type (One Node per Provider)\n",
# 8445     "\n",
# 8446     "This directed graph visualizes the **execution flow between unique providers** involved in a single run.\n",
# 8447     "\n",
# 8448     "# # # #  🧠 What this code does:\n",
# 8449     "- Extracts all log entries that include a `file_name`, sorted by time.\n",
# 8450     "- Groups logs by unique `(provider_type, provider_id)` pairs to ensure **each provider appears only once**.\n",
# 8451     "- Builds a directed graph showing **execution order** from one provider to the next.\n",
# 8452     "- Colors each node by `provider_type` (e.g. `system`, `state`, `agent`, `tool`) using a consistent palette.\n",
# 8453     "- Labels nodes as `<provider_type> (ID <provider_id>)`, making it easy to trace control flow.\n",
# 8454     "\n",
# 8455     "# # # #  🔍 What you're observing:\n",
# 8456     "- **Nodes** represent provider instances (e.g., `agent (ID 2)`, `tool (ID 1)`).\n",
# 8457     "- **Edges** represent transitions between providers during file processing, preserving execution order.\n",
# 8458     "- The layout is **stable** using a fixed seed, so it won't change between runs.\n",
# 8459     "- Helps reveal **which components are chained**, reused, or terminal in the flow.\n",
# 8460     "\n",
# 8461     "This visualization is especially useful for understanding how files propagate through an FSM-controlled execution graph, and for debugging orchestration logic.\n"
# 8462    ]
# 8463   },

# 8481    "source": [
# 8482     "import networkx as nx\n",
# 8483     "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
# 8484     "\n",
# 8485     "#  Sort and dedupe by provider (only first appearance matters here)\n",
# 8486     "df_files = df[df[\"file_name\"].notna()].sort_values(\"timestamp\").copy()\n",
# 8487     "df_files = df_files[[\"timestamp\", \"provider_type\", \"provider_id\", \"file_name\"]].drop_duplicates()\n",
# 8488     "df_files[\"node\"] = df_files.apply(lambda row: f\"{row['provider_type']} (ID {row['provider_id']})\", axis=1)\n",
# 8489     "\n",
# 8490     "#  One row per provider node\n",
# 8491     "df_nodes = df_files.drop_duplicates(subset=[\"node\"]).reset_index(drop=True)\n",
# 8492     "\n",
# 8493     "#  Build node color mapping\n",
# 8494     "provider_types = df_nodes[\"provider_type\"].unique()\n",
# 8495     "color_map = dict(zip(provider_types, plt.get_cmap(\"tab10\").colors[:len(provider_types)]))\n",
# 8496     "node_colors = df_nodes[\"provider_type\"].map(color_map)\n",
# 8497     "\n",
# 8498     "#  Build edges between nodes (based on execution order)\n",
# 8499     "edges = []\n",
# 8500     "for i in range(1, len(df_nodes)):\n",
# 8501     "    prev = df_nodes.iloc[i - 1]\n",
# 8502     "    curr = df_nodes.iloc[i]\n",
# 8503     "    edges.append((prev[\"node\"], curr[\"node\"], curr[\"file_name\"]))\n",
# 8504     "\n",
# 8505     "#  Create graph\n",
# 8506     "G = nx.DiGraph()\n",
# 8507     "for src, tgt, label in edges:\n",
# 8508     "    G.add_edge(src, tgt, label=\"file\")\n",
# 8509     "\n",
# 8510     "#  Draw with color\n",
# 8511     "plt.figure(figsize=(14, 8))\n",
# 8512     "pos = nx.spring_layout(G, k=0.6, seed=32)  #  🔒 fixed layout\n",
# 8513     "\n",
# 8514     "nx.draw(\n",
# 8515     "    G, pos,\n",
# 8516     "    with_labels=True,\n",
# 8517     "    labels={node: node for node in G.nodes},\n",
# 8518     "    node_color=node_colors,\n",
# 8519     "    node_size=2000,\n",
# 8520     "    edge_color='gray',\n",
# 8521     "    arrows=True,\n",
# 8522     "    font_size=10\n",
# 8523     ")\n",
# 8524     "\n",
# 8525     "nx.draw_networkx_edge_labels(\n",
# 8526     "    G, pos,\n",
# 8527     "    edge_labels=nx.get_edge_attributes(G, 'label'),\n",
# 8528     "    font_size=8\n",
# 8529     ")\n",
# 8530     "\n",
# 8531     "plt.title(\"Provider Flow by Actor Type\", fontsize=14)  #  ⛔ no unsupported emoji\n",
# 8532     "plt.show()"
# 8533    ]

# 10875     "import plotly.express as px\n",
# 10876     "\n",
# 10877     "#  Truncate provider_type to the part after the last '.'\n",
# 10878     "df['provider_type'] = df['provider_type'].apply(lambda x: x.split('.')[-1])\n",
# 10879     "\n",
# 10880     "#  Sum latency by provider type\n",
# 10881     "latency_by_type = (\n",
# 10882     "    df.groupby(\"provider_type\")[\"latency_ms\"]\n",
# 10883     "    .sum()\n",
# 10884     "    .reset_index()\n",
# 10885     "    .sort_values(\"latency_ms\", ascending=False)\n",
# 10886     ")\n",
# 10887     "\n",
# 10888     "#  Plot as bar chart\n",
# 10889     "fig = px.bar(\n",
# 10890     "    latency_by_type,\n",
# 10891     "    x=\"provider_type\",\n",
# 10892     "    y=\"latency_ms\",\n",
# 10893     "    text=\"latency_ms\",\n",
# 10894     "    title=\"⏱️ Total Latency by Provider Type\",\n",
# 10895     "    labels={\"provider_type\": \"Provider Type\", \"latency_ms\": \"Total Latency (ms)\"},\n",

# 10898     ")\n",
